exposure: Placenta adhesiva (accreta) involving the urinary bladder
cohort: Four multigravida women diagnosed antenatally with placenta adhesiva suspected to involve the urinary bladder.
finding: Cesarean hysterectomy, performed with careful preparation and a comprehensive team approach, resulted in promising outcomes for the four cases of placenta adhesiva involving the urinary bladder.
mod_finding: Cesarean hysterectomy was the chosen method of delivery and management in all four cases of placenta adhesiva with urinary bladder involvement, demonstrating promising maternal outcomes.
gest_age: Cases were identified and presented between 20 and 33 weeks gestational age.
